review: Fresh replay passed all 2048 original no-hook calls. The selected cohort uses positive nonzero quotients with exponent low-byte shifts 0..15 and finite ratios 0..100. The independent oracle rounds requested and quotient to binary32 separately, divides in binary32, then compares the fixed-point result after scaling by 2^15 and truncating. It checks output and R0-R3, callee-saved registers, full mapped RAM, SP/PC/PRIMASK and pinned flash.
limitations: FPSCR begins at zero with FP enabled; result flags are not checked.
No zero quotient, exceptional FP, overflow/trap, alternate rounding mode, or subnormal claim.
The finite oracle uses host double division followed by binary32 rounding; scope is limited to the tested finite cohort.
Partial/unaccepted; no C implementation or coverage/gate promotion.
